project.title: Pitch Coach
project.medium: Singing trainer plugin – C++, JUCE (AU, VST3, standalone)
project.content:
A plugin that listens while you sing and shows how close you are to the note.

It tracks the pitch of the voice in real time and draws it against a guide melody on a piano-roll, in the key and scale of the song. Every held note gets its deviation in cents, and the panels above sum up the take: how many notes landed on target, how far off they were on average, and how quickly each note was reached. The previous take can stay visible for comparison.
